Metadata.description: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.

Auth.logInIntro: Track jobs, your applications and your profile.
Auth.signUpIntro: The first account on a new server becomes its admin.
Auth.name: Name

personal.heading: Personal details
personal.intro: What forms ask about you. Your first and last name also become your account name, used on resumes and letters.
personal.genderHint: Only for forms that ask. Never put on resumes.

about.heading: About you
about.headline: Headline
about.headlineHint: One line, like “Frontend engineer who loves design systems”
about.languagesHint: With your real level, e.g. German A2, English C1. Resumes copy it exactly.

answers.heading: Application answers
answers.intro: What every application form asks. The Apply kit gives these to Claude for the cover letter and to Claude in Chrome to fill in forms, exactly as you write them here. Leave out anything you don’t want shared.
answers.addressHint: City and country, or the full address forms ask for
answers.workPermitHint: e.g. EU Blue Card, or no visa needed in the EU
answers.notesHint: Short answers you reuse, like why you are looking for a new job. Claude adapts them to each job.

custom.heading: Your own fields
custom.intro: Anything else forms ask, like Xing, pronouns or a portfolio. The Apply kit passes them on as you write them.
custom.name: Field {n} name

resume.heading: Master resume
resume.intro: Your full resume as plain text. Match scores and tailored resumes start from this.
resume.languageHint: Jobs in this language are checked against it. Add other languages below.
resume.upload: Upload a PDF or Word file
resume.uploadHint: Up to 5 MB. Scanned images can’t be read.
resume.read: Resume read. The text below is what we’ll use; fix anything that came out wrong.

errors.years: Years of experience must be between 0 and 60
errors.fieldsMax: Add at most 30 fields of your own

other.heading: Resume in other languages
other.intro: Optional. Jobs whose ad is in one of these languages are checked against that resume, and the Claude prompt starts from it. Your master resume above stays the main one.
other.savedNote: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved. Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.savedNoteFile: ✓ Your {language} resume is saved (read from {file}). Jobs in {language} now use it.
other.noResume: No {language} resume yet? Let Claude translate your master resume. The prompt keeps every employer, date and number, and your real language levels.
other.copyPrompt: Copy translation prompt and open Claude ↗
other.copied: Copied. Paste it into Claude, then paste Claude’s answer below.
other.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the prompt below instead.
other.uploadSaves: Uploading a file saves it straight away: no need to click Save.

design.heading: Resume and cover letter design
design.intro: How the PDFs you download for a job look. Every template is one column with real text, so applicant tracking systems read it.
design.rendererOff: The PDF renderer isn’t running, so downloads are plain PDFs for now. Start it with
design.rendererMissing: PDF templates are switched off: set PDF_RENDERER_URL in .env, then start the renderer with
design.wordColours: Your Word file keeps its own colours and fonts; these are for the cover letter.
design.showPhoto: Show my photo on the resume
design.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 2 MB. Common in Germany, optional elsewhere.
design.saved: Design saved. Your next PDF downloads use it.
design.wordNone: Want your own layout? Upload your master resume as a Word (.docx) file above, and “My own Word file” appears here.
design.wordUnusable: {file} can’t be used as a template yet.
design.wordUses: My own Word file uses {file}: everything above your first heading stays as it is, and each section is written in the style of yours (found: {sections}).
design.wordPdf: Step 3 of the Apply kit then offers a Word download you can edit. The PDF is made with LibreOffice, which may swap a font it doesn’t have; for an exact PDF, open the Word file and save it as PDF.

matcher.intro: Scores each job against your resume (ATS score) and writes a tailored version.
matcher.changeAi: . To change it, set RM_LLM_MODEL in .env, or pick one in
matcher.testHint: Sends one tiny message to the AI provider.
matcher.sending: Sending… Resume-Matcher’s AI is reading your resume, which can take a minute.
